figures.alt: The visual interface of the simulation includes 3 fields labelling the initial velocity, the acceleration and the max time. These correspond to how a bicycle moves across the screen below. While the bike crosses the screen you can see the function of the motion with time on position, velocity and acceleration graphs.

attrs.description:
Visualises how 1d motion can be represented on position, velocity and acceleration-time graphs.
Initial exploration after an introduction.
